title: Wire Python SOS TX as dispatch 0x16
description: Implement the Python SOS sender path so the canonical SOS alert CBOR is wrapped with the SOS L2 dispatch 0x16 before link transmission. Add a focused independent test asserting dispatch and payload preservation.
close_reason: Implemented Python SOS TX dispatch 0x16: added L2_DISPATCH_SOS, SOS classification, wrap_sos_payload, Node.transmit_sos, independent vector updates, and frame-level/node plus payload tests. Verified python/tests/test_l2_payload.py: 264 passed; Ruff and compileall passed. test_node.py collection remains unavailable because declared dependency lora_medium is not installed. Delegated Kimi K3 reviews were attempted for correctness/security/edge and all failed before review due insufficient OpenRouter credits; manual passes found no defects.
